title: Signature Graphics / object and Wi-Fi campaign
slide_intent: Let the same construction express a single object or a service so recognition extends beyond destinations.
strategic_value: The line-based style can connect DB service messages to its broader identity.
demonstration: A dark lightbulb silhouette made from bars on a light field sits beside a MEHR NETZ IM ZUG campaign with a lilac Wi-Fi graphic.
practical_value: Compare a standalone pictorial shape with a service symbol paired with a headline.

content_islands.name: Service campaign
